mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity risk exposure and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing by more than 100k in a month), consumer spending and corporate revenue growth accelerate, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly increase)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
